movesets.name: Paper Cut
movesets.description:
Kartana functions as a deadly wallbreaker, capable of devastating defensive cores such as Gliscor, Toxapex, and Ferrothorn by virtue of its incredibly high Attack stat as well as access to Swords Dance. Furthermore, its Speed enables it to outspeed Pokemon such as Garchomp, allowing it to revenge kill them at +2. Sacred Sword hits Steel-types such as Melmetal, Ferrothorn, and Kingambit, securing a 2HKO on Melmetal at +2. +2 Breakneck Blitz can be used in order to OHKO defensive pivots such as Zapdos and Moltres as well as other defensive Pokemon such as Mega Venusaur. Knock Off allows Kartana to hit bulky Ghost-types such as Pecharunt and Gholdengo hard, securing OHKOs on both at +2. +2 All-Out Pummeling lets it pick up OHKOs on other defensive pivots such as Corviknight and Skarmory after Stealth Rock.

Kartana fits best on balance and bulky offense teams where it functions as a strong wallbreaker, capable of ravaging stall and bulkier teams. Pokemon such as Gholdengo and Zamazenta make for excellent teammates offensively, as they benefit from Kartana's ability to break through special and physical walls such as Ting-Lu and Toxapex, respectively. In return, Gholdengo aids Kartana by breaking through physical walls that it may struggle with such as Corviknight and Skarmory, while Zamazenta threatens most bulky Steel-types such as Melmetal. However, Kartana's poor special bulk leaves it weak to almost every special attacker in the format such as Raging Bolt, Mega Diancie, and Mega Latios, while its typing leaves it vulnerable to Fighting-types such as Zamazenta and Mega Lopunny as well as Fire-types such as Cinderace and Iron Moth. Hence, Kartana appreciates Pokemon such as Ting-Lu and Gliscor that can sponge most special hits with ease. Pecharunt, Toxapex, and Galarian Slowking make for excellent teammates by virtue of checking most Pokemon that Kartana may struggle with or face the threat of being revenge killed by such as Fighting-types like Choice Scarf Urshifu-R and Mega Lopunny as well as special attackers like Iron Valiant and Iron Moth. Moreover, Galarian Slowking is capable of checking offensive structures comprising of Tapu Koko and special Iron Valiant variants that may trouble Kartana while also providing valuable Future Sight support, aiding Kartana in wallbreaking and acting as a strong defensive pivot.

movesets.name: Paper Plane
movesets.description:
Despite Kartana's Speed being nothing short of average, access to a Choice Scarf allows it to outspeed most threats and gain momentum with Beast Boost after a KO, enabling it to act as a strong revenge killer and late-game sweeper. Knock Off enables Kartana to 2HKO bulky Ghost-types such as Gholdengo after some chip damage from entry hazards, whereas Sacred Sword allows it to hit Steel-types such as Melmetal. Defog can be used over Smart Strike in order to remove hazards.

Choice Scarf Kartana fits best on balance and bulky offense teams, where its teammates appreciate its ability to revenge kill Pokemon such as Mega Diancie and Iron Valiant. However, due to Kartana's poor STAB combination and coverage, it effectively becomes a highly exploitable Choice-locked Pokemon that many foes can freely set up on such as Dragonite and Volcarona. As a result, Kartana appreciates having teammates in Ting-Lu, Toxapex, and Zapdos, all of which are able to check most of the aformentioned threats. Kartana's poor special bulk leaves it weak to a majority of the format's special attackers such as Mega Latios and Mega Charizard Y, both of which Kartana is unable to KO without significant chip damage or if it's locked into the wrong move. Moreover, its typing leaves it vulnerable to Fire- and Fighting-types such as Zamazenta or Cinderace. Hence, Kartana appreciates teammates such as Pecharunt, Moltres, and Heatran to switch into its numerous threats.

movesets.name: Paper Fan
movesets.description:
Kartana functions as a unique offensive Defogger. It uses its good defensive typing and access to reliable recovery in Synthesis to offensively check threatening Ground-types while removing the entry hazards that they set. Its ability to threaten common hazard setters such as Gliscor, Ting-Lu, Great Tusk, and Hisuian Samurott makes it a decent Defogger even in spite of its relatively mediocre matchup versus Gholdengo. Knock Off is the preferred coverage move, as it applies some pressure to Gholdengo. It also removes items from Pokemon such as Zapdos, Moltres, and Dragonite that this Kartana set cannot pressure much otherwise, although Dragonite and bulky Gholdengo can still set up on it. Sacred Sword is an alternative that allows Kartana to check Kingambit and pressure Ferrothorn and Melmetal more appreciably than Knock Off, although being a Defogger that cannot pressure Gholdengo at all is not preferable. Grassium Z alongside 120 EVs in Attack allows Kartana to OHKO offensive Garchomp with Bloom Doom. 136 EVs are put into HP to allow Kartana to take a couple more hits and notably allow it to take a Ogerpon-W Superpower from full health.

Kartana fits well on certain offensive teams that value its ability to offensively check Ground-types such as Great Tusk, Garchomp, and Ting-Lu. It does this while removing entry hazards and remaining fairly threatening on its own terms. It is an especially good fit on sun teams anchored by Mega Charizard Y, as they require multiple forms of hazard removal and tend to dislike facing many of the tier's Ground-types, especially Garchomp. Kartana's Synthesis also gains a boost when under sun. Kartana's inability to break bulky Gholdengo without significant support is a major hinderance, so teams utilizing it must have other ways to pressure it. Strong Ground- and Fire-types such as Great Tusk, Garchomp, Mega Charizard Y, and Heatran can assist Kartana in taking down Gholdengo and can take advantage of Kartana often forcing Gholdengo to use Recover. They can also pressure Mega Scizor, which is another problematic matchup. Kartana also synergizes well with hazard setters on its own team, as it can potentially beat Gholdengo with Spikes support and force a Knock Off onto foes reliant on Heavy-Duty Boots. Spikes setters such as Gliscor or Stealth Rock setters such as Great Tusk, Garchomp, and Kommo-o are therefore good partners. Kartana's horrible Special Defense prevents it from switching into virtually any special attacker, so teammates such as Galarian Slowking, Gliscor, and Moltres are good teammates. These three are also capable of slotting in pivoting moves, which allows them to keep up momentum for Kartana's offensive teammates. Kartana also often appreciates a second Steel-type, as it defensively functions very differently from other Steel-types due to its inability to check threats such as Tapu Lele, Mega Latios, and Mega Diancie. Gholdengo, Heatran, and Melmetal are good teammates as a result.
